repository.name: @webex/storage-adapter-local-forage
repository.purpose: A localforage-backed (IndexedDB first) implementation of the Webex storage-adapter interface, published to npm so a browser host can persist Webex JS SDK storage namespaces across page reloads and browser restarts.

local-forage-storage-adapter.summary: The published npm surface: the default export StorageAdapterLocalForage (constructor arguments ignored), whose bind(namespace, options) resolves a binding exposing get, put, del, and clear. package.json declares the entry points (main dist/index.js, devMain src/index.js); src/index.js is the authoritative definition of the exported shape, and the owning module spec specifies its behavior.

local-forage-indexeddb-store.summary: The on-device record layout the adapter owns: one record per namespace/key pair, keyed by the template literal namespace + '/' + key, in the origin's default localforage database (name localforage, store keyvaluepairs; IndexedDB, else WebSQL, else localStorage). Values are stored unencrypted and unversioned, persist across sessions and releases, and are erased wholesale by clear(). src/index.js is its only authoritative definition.

storage-adapter-spec-suite.summary: The executable conformance suite defining the Webex storage-adapter interface, run by this package's test. Owned and specified by @webex/storage-adapter-spec; recorded here only as a requirement.

webex-common-js-api.source: Workspace package @webex/common (workspace path packages/@webex/common/src/one-flight.js; canonical spec packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md)
webex-common-js-api.summary: The @webex/common export surface; this package uses only the oneFlight decorator, which de-duplicates concurrent calls per instance, method, and keyFactory key and evicts the flight when it settles.

webex-core-storage-layer.source: Workspace package @webex/webex-core (workspace paths packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/storage/errors.js and packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/storage/make-webex-store.js; no canonical spec exists)
webex-core-storage-layer.summary: The SDK storage layer that drives the adapter: it calls bind(namespace, {logger}) once per namespace, caches the binding, routes get/put/del/clear to it, and treats a NotFoundError rejection as no data. It also exports the NotFoundError class this package rejects with.

localforage-api.source: npm package localforage ^1.7.3, resolved to 1.10.0 by the workspace lockfile
localforage-api.summary: Promise-based key-value storage over IndexedDB, WebSQL, or localStorage. The adapter uses getItem, setItem, removeItem, keys, and clear on the default instance; with no usable driver every call rejects with 'No available storage method found.'
